positions.name: MeridianGateRatification
positions.frame: Which statements ratify the Meridian deploy gate as binding policy — its mandate, scope, and ownership — and which merely explain or justify it?
positions.why: Across dimensions these four read as settling/ratification acts rather than argument: conviction reads each as a 'decision' (performed-act, ratifying language) while the fifth segment in this envelope reads as a 'claim' — a supporting assertion, not itself the settling act. Power and relational readings converge on legitimate, authority-ranking acts binding the deployment process (the directive establishing the requirement, its declarative restatement as a gate, its scope across staging/production, and its named owner). Affect is calm-positive and settled across all four, in contrast to the residual alarm carried by the rationale statement. There is a surface tension worth holding rather than resolving: src-1 is delivered in plain directive prose while src-3/src-4/src-5 shift into a bolded spec-label register — different surface form, same ratifying direction, so the frame holds both as one coherent 'what is binding' read.
